title: Reliable conformal novelty detection at the decision boundary
abstract: arXiv:2601.02610v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Novelty detection via conformal $p$-values and BH procedure provides distribution-free global false discovery rate (FDR) control. We present here fundamental limits of this approach by showing that it does not produce reliable detection at the decision boundary. We study boundary false discovery rate (bFDR), the probability that the least extreme reported novelty is in fact a null observation. We first show that the support line (SL) procedure, controlling the bFDR in the continuous independent framework, fails to control the bFDR in the conformal case. We then present several modifications of the SL procedure that restore reliability at the decision boundary, by controlling the bFDR, with specific improvements in situations where many novelties are expected (adaptive procedures) and when the calibration sample is too small with respect to the test sample (subsampled procedures). translated_title: 决策边界上的可靠共形新颖性检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.02610v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：通过共形p值和BH过程进行的新颖性检测提供了无分布的全局错误发现率（FDR）控制。我们在此展示了这种方法的基本局限性，表明它在决策边界上无法产生可靠的检测。我们研究了边界错误发现率（bFDR），即报告的最不极端新颖性实际上是零观测的概率。我们首先表明，在连续独立框架中控制bFDR的支持线（SL）过程，在共形情况下无法控制bFDR。然后，我们提出了SL过程的几种修改方案，通过控制bFDR来恢复决策边界上的可靠性，并在预期有许多新颖性的情况（自适应过程）以及校准样本相对于测试样本过小的情况（子采样过程）中进行了具体改进。使用合成数据和真实数据进行的数值实验...
tldr: 本文揭示了共形新颖性检测在决策边界上的局限性，并提出修改的支持线过程以控制边界错误发现率，从而在多种场景下恢复检测可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the limitations of conformal novelty detection at the decision boundary and proposes modified support line procedures to control the boundary false discovery rate, restoring detection reliability across various scenarios.
